transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I... well, my family thought I should come. I've been hearing things. Voices, mostly. Clear voices in my apartment. And sometimes when I'm out... like in empty museum rooms. It's usually women, whispering from behind the walls. They... they tell me which photographs belong in the archive.
Do you believe someone is deliberately sending these voices to you?

Yes... I know they are. The museum board, mostly. And the city arts people. They've been monitoring my phone. They know my Caribbean archive will... it will change how the galleries tell the truth. And no one has shown me anything that proves otherwise. So, yes.
Have you had a period when your mood was very high or unusually energetic for days at a time?

I... suppose so. There are days when I just feel... radiant. Like I've been chosen. But... if someone questions my plan, or tells me to slow down... I get furious. It just feels like they're trying to erase me.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do things you used to care about?

I suppose... yes. Sometimes. There are long stretches where I just... sit. At the kitchen table. The herb pots dry out and I don't... I don't really care. People call, friends leave messages about gallery openings or concerts, and I just... I don't call back. I don't really want to go.
Have you heard the voices during times when your mood felt neither especially high nor especially low?

Yes... I suppose. There was a period... maybe a few weeks. I wasn't feeling particularly energized, or... grand. Just... quiet. 

But I still heard the whispers in the apartment. And... I still knew the arts people were monitoring my phone. So... yes.
Have you had a period of at least several days when you felt deeply depressed most of the day?

I... no. I wouldn't say that. 

I don't really feel... sad, or anything like that. Just... like I said before, I just sit there. It's more of a... a blankness. I don't really know if I would call it depressed.
Do the voices ever speak to each other about you?

I... I'm not sure if they talk to each other. I just... I hear them clearly. In the apartment. And sometimes... if I go to the museum, when the rooms are empty. 

It's usually... women. Whispering from behind the walls. They... they tell me which photographs belong in the archive. That's... that's mostly what they say.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

I... yes, I suppose so. Sometimes. 

When there is a lot of work to do... I don't need to sleep much. Maybe... two or three hours. I'll wake up before dawn, and... I just feel completely ready. I don't need rest. Sleep is... it's for people who don't have an archive to rescue. So... I just get up.
During those times when you felt radiant and slept only a few hours, were you more active than usual?

I suppose... yes. 

I just... keep moving. I'll start labeling the photographs, and then... I'll switch to rewriting the donor letters. Then I'll start reorganizing the boxes of old programs. I just... I don't sit down. It feels like... like there's a motor running inside me. I just have to keep doing things.
Did the voices and sense that people were monitoring you start very suddenly, over a day or two?

I... no, I don't think it was just a day or two. It's been... longer than that. 

About eight months, I suppose. That's how long the voices... and knowing they are watching the archive... have been there. I've just... known for about eight months now.
When those radiant, high-energy periods happened, did they ever last for a full week or longer?

Yes... they do. 

Out of the last eight months... I'd say those times... the bursts where I don't sleep, where I have all the plans and the energy, and the... the spending... that's been going on for about six months of it.
